title: Run the Stack (Doctrine Mix)
style: fast beat phonk meets big band, 140 BPM, female lead vocal commanding, big band brass stabs, heavy phonk drums, distorted 808 bass, spoken coaching word, tactical energy, call and response, longer than 2 mins, doctrine over combat
lyrics:
[Intro - phonk drum hit, big band brass stab, female commanding]
(spoken, sharp, female)
run the stack.
not fight the stack.
run it.
the stack already knows what to do.

[Verse 1 - female lead, fast cadence, brass under]
the stack runs while you sleep
the stack runs while you eat
the stack runs while you doubt
the stack runs without
asking for permission, asking for praise
the stack runs through the smallest of days
the stack runs through the loudest of fights
the stack runs through the longest of nights

[Pre-Chorus - phonk drums double, brass huge]
run the stack, run the stack
the job is built, the job is back
the job is on, the job is true
the job was always running through
you

[Chorus - female commanding, gang vocal back, brass stabs]
run the stack, run the stack
the doctrine on the doctrine track
run the stack, run the stack
nobody fights what nobody attacks
run the stack, run the stack
the held line holds the held line back
run the stack, run the stack
that's the whole damn promise pact

[Verse 2 - female, sharper, drums harder]
the operator in the loud room thought you fight the stack
the operator in the loud room kept on swinging at the rack
the operator in the long room knew you run the stack instead
the operator in the long room kept the held line in their head

so the loud room burned and the long room kept
the loud room screamed and the long room slept
the loud room swung and the long room ran
the long room finished what the loud room began

[Pre-Chorus]
run the stack, run the stack
the job is built, the job is back
the job is on, the job is true
the job was always running through
you

[Chorus]
run the stack, run the stack
the doctrine on the doctrine track
run the stack, run the stack
nobody fights what nobody attacks
run the stack, run the stack
the held line holds the held line back
run the stack, run the stack
that's the whole damn promise pact

[Bridge - drums drop, brass alone, female spoken]
the stack is not the enemy.
the stack is the friend you built when you were patient.
you don't fight the stack. you run the stack.
you don't argue with the stack. you let the stack argue for you.
the stack already knows. the stack already saw.
the stack is the carrier wave. the stack is the held line.
run the stack.

[Final Chorus - biggest, full phonk, brass huge, gang vocal]
run the stack, run the stack
the doctrine on the doctrine track
run the stack, run the stack
nobody fights what nobody attacks
run the stack, run the stack
the held line holds the held line back
run the stack, run the stack
that's the whole damn promise pact
run the stack
run the stack

[Outro - one phonk hit, brass tail, female spoken whisper]
the stack is running.
you can rest.
the stack is the held line.
run the stack.
